model_outputs.content:
Imagine you have two magic toy robots. When you press a button on one robot, the other robot does something special at the same time, no matter how far apart they are. If you make one robot dance, the other robot starts dancing too, even if it's on the other side of the playground!

Quantum entanglement is like that. It's when two tiny particles, like little building blocks of everything, are connected in a special way. If you change something about one particle, the other one changes too, even if they're really far apart. It's a bit like magic!
